name: Colorado River — Ruby-Horsethief Canyons
gaugeName: Colorado River near Colorado-Utah State Line (USGS 09163500)
blurb: 25 miles of mostly flatwater through McInnis Canyons NCA from Loma, CO to Westwater, UT. Overnight camping permits required year-round.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Day use needs no permit; overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov 74466). No take-outs until Westwater. Take-out is in Utah. Mileage: BLM Ruby-Horsethief Canyon permits page.

notices.title: Permit
notices.text: BLM: overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov 74466); day use without permit.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 79553
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 79553 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 99 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM launch; day use needs no permit; overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov). (BLM Ruby-Horsethief Canyon permits page, https://www.blm.gov/visit/ruby-horsethief-canyon-permits).

takeOutAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Moab Field Office)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 69678 'Westwater Ranger Station' (Boat Ramp, UTY01000)
takeOutAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 69678 'Westwater Ranger Station' (Boat Ramp, UTY01000) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Moab FO: Westwater Canyon River Permits (https://www.blm.gov/visit/westwater-canyon-river-permits): Directions: 'Westwater Ranger Station (the put-in): From Interstate 70, take exit 227.' Page Geographic Coordinates 39.08638, -109.10142. 'The canyon is 17 miles long and includes Class IV rapids'; permit required. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/westwater_ranger_station_boat_ramp.png): the point is on the bank just upstream of the ramp structures beside the ranger station; the BLM page coordinate is about 20 m south on the same launch. NHD flowline 81 m away.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~152), the point is right of the NHD centreline (81 m).
